Adaptations for a standalone educational image:
- Exported the original SVG and embedded its source figure styles; retained network shapes, arrows, labels and colors.
- Removed two narrative English headnotes and their vertical separator. A separate short Chinese reading caption is supplied by Embodied ML Lab.
- Adjusted the canvas to include the full input-to-output path.
- Raised the opacity of the background sub-networks for legibility.
